comment: Top-of-funnel upgrade metrics: members who viewed the upgrade screen and members who started a paid subscription.

columns.name: Event Date
columns.comment: Calendar date of the funnel event

columns.name: Week
columns.comment: Week (Monday start) of the funnel event
columns.type_json: {"name":"Week","type":"timestamp","nullable":true,"metadata":{"metric_view.expr":"DATE_TRUNC('WEEK', event_date)","comment":"Week (Monday start) of the funnel event","metric_view.type":"dimension"}}

columns.name: Acquisition Channel
columns.comment: Marketing channel that acquired the member

columns.name: Upgrade Viewers
columns.comment: Distinct members who viewed the upgrade screen
columns.type_json: {"name":"Upgrade Viewers","type":"long","nullable":false,"metadata":{"metric_view.expr":"COUNT(DISTINCT member_id) FILTER (WHERE event_name = 'upgrade_viewed')","comment":"Distinct members who viewed the upgrade screen","metric_view.type":"measure"}}

columns.name: Subscribers Started
columns.comment: Distinct members who started a paid subscription
columns.type_json: {"name":"Subscribers Started","type":"long","nullable":false,"metadata":{"metric_view.expr":"COUNT(DISTINCT member_id) FILTER (WHERE event_name = 'subscription_started')","comment":"Distinct members who started a paid subscription","metric_view.type":"measure"}}

columns.name: Upgrade Conversion Rate
columns.type_json: {"name":"Upgrade Conversion Rate","type":"double","nullable":true,"metadata":{"metric_view.expr":"COUNT(DISTINCT member_id) FILTER (WHERE event_name = 'subscription_started') / COUNT(DISTINCT member_id) FILTER (WHERE event_name = 'upgrade_viewed')","comment":"Subscribers Started / Upgrade Viewers","metric_view.type":"measure"}}
